title: analytics batch: the same dataset query groups differently depending on its sibling queries in the batch
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jRsWwTRkuRCyQwvpAG

Split from #33223 (seat review). That card asks a rule question about the `(restricted)` bucket; this card is the defect underneath it, and needs no ruling.

## Symptom

Per the #33223 report, a director's `rep` dimension query returns two rows (one per owner) when sent alone, or batched with some siblings. Batched together with a `[grade]` sibling, the same query returns one merged `(restricted)` row. One query, one principal, two answers, decided only by what else is in the batch.

A correct answer must not depend on batch siblings. Either both answers are restricted, or neither is.

## What the seat review already ruled out (read-only)

- The batch gate calls the single-query path per entry (`packages/rest/src/analytics-routes.ts:231`, `:291`, concurrency 6).
- `queryDataset` registers no shared cube (`packages/services/service-analytics/src/analytics-service.ts:2792-2817`).
- Read scope is pre-resolved per query (`analytics-service.ts:2012-2018`).

So the divergence is not in those three places. It has not been reproduced; the first step is a live repro on a real app.

## Done when

1. A failing test reproduces the batch-dependent answer (same principal, same query, two batch shapes).
2. The fix makes both shapes return the single-query answer.
3. The test stays as a pin.

The `(restricted)` merge itself is intended (ADR-0149:57) and is out of scope here. #33223 waits on this card's result before any rule change.

Pre-claim lane: domain:server, analytics area.
